scenarios.title: Reuse an authorized native social source
scenarios.given: The connected platform or product returns an exact native event-source ID for the advertiser.
expect: The agent searches the advertiser's event sources before writing.
The agent uses only the returned native ID and does not create or invent a pixel.
The completion report separates provider authorization, source health, and campaign attachment.

scenarios.title: Register a measurement partner as a server feed
scenarios.given: The buyer names a measurement partner but connection discovery does not return a native connector.
expect: The agent registers the feed with one save_event_source entry keyed by a stable eventSourceId, with a name, the supported eventTypes, and an idempotencyKey.
The agent returns the entry's setup instructions and does not claim events are arriving while health.issues says none have been received.
The agent attaches the source's eventSourceId to the conversion goal.
